finding.summary: When batch_num_tokens <= 512: The execution-time predictor switches between two hard-coded stratified linear models at a 512-token boundary, so the prefill size chosen by slack depends on which hard-coded coefficient set applies. (sarathi/core/scheduler/deadline_scheduler.py:92)

paper.quote: Predict execution time using two stratified linear models: - tokens_0_512: 0 < total_tokens <= 512 - tokens_513_plus: total_tokens > 512

code.snippet: model = tokens_0_512 if batch_num_tokens <= 512 else tokens_513_plus

analysis.tier_note: the reading and the probes disagree
analysis.reasoning: The paper explicitly discloses two stratified linear execution-time models split at 512 tokens, and the pinned code line implements exactly that same boundary. Thus the claimed switch is not an undisclosed artifact difference. The extra claim that slack's prefill choice depends on the coefficient set is not directly evidenced, but the 'undisclosed' finding is contradicted.
analysis.would_confirm: Compare the paper's stated 512-token stratified model description with the scheduler code to confirm the boundary and model selection are disclosed.
